The fed's own served Pandemonium PPV recap, dated the same day, does not itself narrate a vacating — it shows Speed Racer defending and retaining the U.S. Title in a straight match against Sinister Sean Blake that same night (Commissioner Clayton's own on-air announcement calls him "the U.S. Champ" going into it), and its own introduction for the later World Title main event billed Most Holy — not Speed Racer — as "The U.S. Champion," a discrepancy between the two served primary sources the held record does not otherwise resolve.
